raw.notes: ENA shows 0 samples for PRJNA514908; this is an NCBI BioProject accession not mirrored to ENA. Paper explicitly deposits 46 Klebsiella WGS genomes under this accession. All 46 were AMR-selected: recovered on MacConkey agar containing 1 mg/L meropenem, confirmed carbapenemase-positive by CarbaNP (phenotypic), then PCR-typed as NDM-5; 46 isolates spanning 5 PFGE pulsotypes selected for WGS. Non-human hosts (migratory birds, predominantly Anser indicus bar-headed geese), so cohort_age is not applicable. Isolation sources across the 233 Klebsiella pool span bird feces (230/233) plus 2 soil and 1 feather; exact source breakdown for the 46 WGS isolates is not stated, preventing a single whole-project isolation_source or host backfill. All samples collected in August 2016 at Qinghai Lake, China; midpoint 2016-08-15 proposed for collection_date.
